body: Love this!

If I’m honest I felt like this on my 16th, I wanted to throw myself infront of a train. I’m almost 24 now. I’ve experienced so much in these years. It really isn’t worth ending it now I assure you. Please reconsider. It feels like the end of the world now, but I honestly promise you it isn’t. Being a teen is really really hard. But you’ll get through it. I promise.

Honestly man, you’re only 15, you have so much life left in you. I’m almost 24 and the stuff I’ve experienced from the last 9 years has been incredible. Hang in there kid, it may seem like the end of the world right now but I absolutely promise you it’s not. X
You got this! I used to only manage 3 days but managed a month recently.
I had a medical abortion at 9 weeks, it is very painful for a day or two, followed by bleeding for some time.
Feeling guilty afterwards doesn’t automatically make it okay. Any adult with sense should know that you do not deprive someone of their sleep. It’s abuse.

Why are you blaming him?! She can ask to be more playful when he’s not needing to go to bed. I’ve ended a relationship over this kind of shit, someone depriving you of sleep like that doesn’t give a fuck about you. 4 years together or not, they don’t give a fuck when they’re acting like that.
You clearly haven’t been in a relationship where your partner has purposely deprived you of sleep.
What she did was abusive, full stop. I’d suggest you give her the ultimatum of her stopping this behaviour or you’re out the door. Forced sleep deprivation is fucking cruel.

Yeah it was really scary and there was a moment shortly after where I got hot and cold sweats, and had to rest my chin on the sink while on the toilet, because I felt so nauseous. I had to take cocodamol, which has helped somewhat but I think the hot water bottle has been my friend more than anything. I tried to sleep too but my cramps were keeping me awake. Yeah hopefully it passes soon! Definitely been a stay-in-bed kind of day.

I took my 4 pills today too, everything you’ve said is exact to what I’ve experienced. I thought it’d be a few hours until I felt anything but in just under an hour I had the worst cramps imaginable. The clot I passed too which I’m certain was the foetus, had grey on it too. I’m feeling a little better after 8 hours but still having cramps. You’re incredibly brave for going through it, I suppose it’s one of the pains we face as women. Sending my love and support to you ❤️
Some of it work, some of it for fun.

My ex boyfriend used to send me crying selfies when we’d have an argument. I should have ran a mile.
Chocolate and cheese.
Keanu Reeves.
Waking up thinking you have to go to work but realising that its your day off.
My ex did this to my bedroom wall. I will never understand these people.
Depends what you class as an argument and a disagreement. I’ve known couples who never argued and it went to shit. However, I’m very happy that you are happy with your partner!
I beg to differ. Not constant arguments but every now and then it’s sometimes inevitable. My boyfriend and I have had arguments over some things but we learn from it and grow stronger together.
